escenarios.desc: Climb to a random height and hold still for 3 s. The first thing an AI learns from zero.
escenarios.trabajos: None yet: it's the base of everything

escenarios.desc: Go to a random point and hold for 3 s looking where it's told: a photo without the house.
escenarios.trabajos: 👉 Doña Marta's photo (level 0) and the easy ★ photos

escenarios.desc: Follow a curved line without leaving it: go exactly where it's told.
A real photo: arrive, brake and frame the house (or the roof) right in the center.
escenarios.trabajos: ★★ photos and up (house centered, with wind, farther away) and roof inspections

escenarios.desc: Several photos in a row around the subject: the same plan, repeated with a for.
Fly through a series of rings: so it doesn't forget to move fast and precisely.
escenarios.trabajos: Precision training (no jobs for this yet)

escenarios.desc: Follow a camera path (static, orbit, reveal) with the house centered, without losing it.
Reach the goal dodging columns: it learns not to crash.
The same shots with wind gusts: hold on without losing the framing.
Film with poles a meter and a half from the path: real precision.
Carry a package to a far platform (sometimes on a rooftop) dodging buildings, and hold still above it so it can land.
escenarios.trabajos: Deliveries (they come with the big workshop)

escenarios.desc: A track of gates far apart: pass them fast and in order. Your model can be the freestyle rival.
escenarios.trabajos: The racing league and the freestyle rivals

escenarios.desc: Catch the hare, a target that runs and changes direction: cut the corners. Your model can chase you in freestyle.
escenarios.trabajos: League chases and the freestyle chaser
